
// (type any)
type Type_any struct {
	backref    any
	refcount   int
	P_type     *Type_type
	P_const    *Type_const
	P_msgblock *Type_msgblock
	P_delta    *Type_delta
	P_isrun    bool
}

// V_constructor_any
func V_constructor_any() *Type_any {
	var output *Type_any = new(Type_any)
	return output
}

// V_create_any
func V_create_any() *Type_any {
	var output *Type_any = V_constructor_any()
	V_initialize_any(
		output)
	return output
}

// V_initialize_any
func V_initialize_any(
	value *Type_any) {
	value.P_type = T_any
	value.backref = value
}

// V_release_any
func V_release_any(
	value *Type_any) *Type_any {
	if value != E_any {
		V_release_any(
			value)
	}
	var output *Type_any = E_any
	return output
}

// V_shutdown_any
func V_shutdown_any(
	value *Type_any) {
	value.backref = nil
	var type_msgblock *Type_msgblock = value.P_msgblock
	if type_msgblock != E_msgblock {
		value.P_msgblock = E_msgblock
		V_release_any(
			type_msgblock.P_any)
	}
	var type_const *Type_const = value.P_const
	if type_const != E_const {
		value.P_const = E_const
		V_release_any(
			type_const.P_any)
	}
	value.P_type = E_type
}

// V_startup_any
func V_startup_any() *Type_type {
	var t_variable *Type_type = T_any
	var e_variable *Type_any = E_any
	V_initialize_any(
		e_variable)
	V_type_t_startup(
		t_variable,
		"vx/core",
		"any",
		"any",
		E_string,
		e_variable)
	t_variable.P_propertymap = V_varmap_from_listvar(
		[]*Type_var{
			V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
				"backref",
				T_any),
			V_var_new_private_from_namen_type(
				"refcount",
				T_intn),
			V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
				"type",
				T_type),
			V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
				"const",
				T_const),
			V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
				"msgblock",
				T_msgblock),
			V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
				"delta",
				T_delta),
			V_var_new_public_from_namen_type(
				"isrun",
				T_booleann)})
	var output *Type_type = t_variable
	return output
}

// V_any_from_type_backref
func V_any_from_type_backref(
	type_type *Type_type,
	backref any) *Type_any {
	var output *Type_any = V_create_any()
	output.P_type = type_type
	output.backref = backref
	return output
}

// V_cast_any
func V_cast_any(
	type_type *Type_type,
	type_any *Type_any) *Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_type(
		type_type)
	var output *Type_any = V_cast_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_type,
		type_any)
	return output
}

// A_copy_any
func A_copy_any(
	type_any *Type_any,
	type_anylist *Type_anylist) *Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output *Type_any = V_copy_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any,
		type_anylist)
	return output
}

// V_new_any
func V_new_any(
	type_type *Type_type,
	type_anylist *Type_anylist) *Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_type(
		type_type)
	var output *Type_any = V_new_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_type,
		type_anylist)
	return output
}

// V_count_any
func V_count_any(
	type_any *Type_any) int {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output int = V_count_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any)
	return output
}

// V_get_keyn_any
func V_get_keyn_any(
	type_any *Type_any,
	keyn string) *Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output *Type_any = V_get_keyn_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any,
		keyn)
	return output
}

// V_get_indexn_any
func V_get_indexn_any(
	type_any *Type_any,
	indexn int) *Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output *Type_any = V_get_indexn_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any,
		indexn)
	return output
}

// V_listany_any
func V_listany_any(
	type_any *Type_any) []*Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output []*Type_any = V_listany_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any)
	return output
}

// V_listkey_any
func V_listkey_any(
	type_any *Type_any) []string {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output []string = V_listkey_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any)
	return output
}

// V_mapany_any
func V_mapany_any(
	type_any *Type_any) map[string]*Type_any {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	var output map[string]*Type_any = V_mapany_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any)
	return output
}

// V_release_any
func V_release_any(
	type_any *Type_any) {
	type_any.refcount -= 1
	if type_any.refcount <= 0 {
		if type_any.refcount < 0 {
			V_log_stringn(
				"Error: Negative Refcount - " +
					V_typenamen_from_any(
						type_any))
		}
		V_shutdown_any(
			type_any)
	}
}

// V_reserve_any
func V_reserve_any(
	type_any *Type_any) {
	type_any.refcount += 1
}

// V_shutdown_any
func V_shutdown_any(
	type_any *Type_any) {
	var type_generic *Type_generic = V_generic_from_any(
		type_any)
	V_shutdown_from_generic(
		type_generic,
		type_any)
}

// F_any
func F_any(
	type_type *Type_type,
	type_anylist *Type_anylist) *Type_any {
	var output *Type_any = V_new_any(
		type_type,
		type_anylist)
	return output
}

var T_any *Type_type = V_constructor_type()
var E_any *Type_any = V_constructor_any()
